bun-box.name: Bun Intended buns in their kraft trays
bun-box.traits: soft, tall, hand-rolled cinnamon buns with uneven swirls, packed in long kraft paper trays: Classic with a loose white drizzle, caramel with a glossy caramel-coffee glaze pooled in the swirl, Lotus heaped with white cream and coarse Lotus biscuit crumbs. Not perfectly round or centred, not paler or flatter than in the photo; no 'Lotus' lettering on any crumb.
bun-box.source: their only photo of the buns (scrollcraft/builds/bun-intended/message-to-owner.md:5-7). The bun cut-outs in assets/ are not safe masters: the chocolate one is generated and the espresso one is in doubt. A bun once came out paler, flatter and too perfect (memory: generate-right-first-time); the model drew 'Lotus' on a biscuit (gen/bun-brief.md:19).
